file_contents.AGENTS.md:
# Repository instructions

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` (or `make test`) before pushing.
CI runs the same suite on every push and pull request.
Keep schema changes and adapter changes in separate commits when practical.
Design decisions live in `docs/decisions/`; if a change alters something a
note there describes, update the note in the same PR.
file_contents.CONTRIBUTING.md:
# Contributing

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` (or `make test`) before pushing.
CI runs the same suite on every push and pull request.

If a change alters something a design note describes, update the note in the
same pull request. Reviewers ask for this. The pull request template has a
checklist for both of these.

test:
